arChildNodes.szComment: Player lead-in line: "Mephisto? You know who Akarat really is."
[PH] The Hand of Akarat groans and doubles over. His eyes go black. Mephisto asserts control over his body, and we hear his voice.
The Hand of Akarat slits himself open with a large and grotesque cut across his body, and jumps into the sea. The ocean boils, spectacle visuals. The sea Abomination fight begins.
